status.current_claim: UCNS currently supports bounded candidate-scoped, option-preserving multimodal relation representation while preserving unresolved construction choices explicitly. For the active lexical program, the exact xkcd Simple Writer 0.2.1 surface inventory is the lexical-floor source and OEWN 2025 Core is the primary contemporary lexical-semantic corpus. The operative sequence is characters -> morphology -> definitions -> recursive gonol relations. Relationships enter gonols; once constructed, a word or definition gonol is atomic at the next scale; affixiation names the scale-invariant coupling/closure pattern, not merely prefix/suffix morphology; and direct coupling across non-adjacent scales is permitted without requiring intermediate closures to be reopened. The Public Gonol table supplies definition-derived functions for all 84 admitted punctuation/symbol positions. The xkcd floor reconstruction candidate uses those functions as intrinsic participants with exact source order, occurrence, and multiplicity, requires explicit occurrence-addressed application context, and binds ordered application identities into the receipt; it is not selected canon. The punctuation-aware OEWN first-recursion layer is sealed and independently replayed: closed lemma/form word gonols stay atomic, leftover Public Gonol glyphs are function participants, and native OEWN relation labels remain unselected. The morphology decomposition law remains unresolved. Falsifier baselines follow completion of the intended gonol system rather than gating its construction. The intended PTCNA remains downstream of a not-yet-performed UCNS audit of a functioning conventional neural network.
status.current_definition: UCNS is option-preserving multimodal geometric relation-carrier research. A UCNS representation preserves relations among heterogeneous objects without requiring those objects to become numerically identical, modality-identical, or topologically identical; completion remains relative to a declared construction boundary.
